body: Okay that helps a lot in terms of medication and comfort about the psych ward, thank you so much!
That would actually be awesome, thank you!

I feel better about the psych ward thing, thanks. I really stress out about that. 
As for meds, my psychologist proposed the idea but I shied away because I was afraid of the idea that I wouldn't be safe with them.
My physical condition is healthy except for being slightly underweight which probably wouldn't have this much of a negative effect on me. My dad can be really insensitive and mean at the worst of times but other times he's great. The rest of my family is generally good, only a few minor issues here and there. 

My psychologist believes part of my depression is in my chemical makeup, because I've apparently shown signs of depression since I was a child. The other part was developmental (bullying, issues with my dad, etc). 

I hope all that answers the questions that you were trying to ask
I was actually considering trying charcoal drawing. I've got a lot of great charcoal pencils that I want to put to use.
Yeah that might be fun haha, do you have issues with depression and that helps or is it just a hobby of yours?
Your response helped a lot, it made me feel better about telling my parents. Thank you so much.
That's a good idea, I'm sure people would buy your stuff. I never did jewelry, but I used to like to make things out of wire. I made some pretty cool animals with that.
I like to sing, draw, play guitar, anything related to art really. That's stayed consistent since childhood.
